I see the dbus-sensors commit for the new device is https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/77020.
Need to wait for the SQ52205 driver and dbus-sensor support to show up, right?

https://github.com/facebookexternal/openbmc.wiwynn/blob/c883d273ff223e49b64262f5a20747e1f6dfd748/common/recipes-kernel/linux/6.6/0309-Add-SQ52205-driver.patch#L4

Please refer to the patch located at `./common/recipes-kernel/linux/6.6/0309-Add-SQ52205-driver.patch`.
LORE link: https://lore.kernel.org/all/20240812154240.3570-1-wenliang202407@163.com/

The driver has been integrated into facebookexternal.

I mentioned this in the dbus-sensors commit also.

The Lore link you've pointed to is from August and was rejected by maintainers (with feedback).  I don't see any follow ups and the code isn't merged into master yet.  We need someone to follow up and get the code merged into Linux before we accept userspace references to it.

(1) The model name sq52205 is changed to sy24655.
(2) According to the upstream's suggestion, supports the SQ52205 by applying a patch in the INA2xx driver. The patch is applied in linux kernel 6.13.

We are modifying the code. Temporarily set the status to WIP.
The driver for SY24655 (SQ52205) has been supported by the ina2xx.c since Linux kernel version 6.13.
We are still encountering the CI failure.

Your commit is still based on one that is 20 commits old:

```
$ git rev-list origin/master ^2e98156a5032aba4c195225f79b79a47920eba03 | wc -l              
20
```

Please rebase before you submit to Gerrit.
Thank you for the reminder, the rebase has been done.
this'll need another rebase since there's now an auto-generated configurations/meson.build.
Please run `scripts/generate_config_list.sh` to get these added to the appropriate meson file.  That is why this is failing CI.
